From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + proposed hosted access & canary routing playbook

Hi Harper — thanks again for the demo chat this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move your hosted evaluation forward: 

Use case summary:
- BrightCart will use Redwood for cart summarization + multi-turn search assistance inside checkout (high QPS, low-latency target).
- Sensitive PII fields are tokenized client-side; team wants logs retained for 30 days for debugging.

What we heard you need from Hosted for the eval:
- Staging and prod endpoints with separate API keys (scoped).
- A simple canary routing pattern to ramp from 5% -> 25% -> 100% traffic.
- Clear per-endpoint rate limits and token quotas for the pilot.
- Lightweight procurement (trial terms) and a short ops checklist for compliance.

Questions / clarifications for you:
1) Can you confirm target peak RPS for inference on checkout path (approx tokens per request)?
2) Any must-have regions (we have us-west & eu-west hosted endpoints)?
3) Who should be on the procurement thread (procurement@... ok)?

Attached: redwood-playbook-v1.pdf (playbook + canary checklist stub), canary-checklist.csv (template for rollout percentages).

Proposed next steps (timeline):
- This week: we provision eval endpoints and share scoped API keys (SE assigned).
- +3 business days: run smoke tests with ~1k requests/min.
- +1 week: canary ramp if smoke tests pass (we'll manage routing rules).

If that looks right I can kick off provisioning and assign Aditya as your SE for the technical ramp. Available times for a 30-min kickoff: Mon 2/22 10:00-11:00 PT or Tue 2/23 14:00-15:00 PT.

Thanks — Soojin

Hi Harper — Aditya from SE here, thanks for the context. I skimmed your traffic profile and sketched a pragmatic hosted canary plan and rate guidance below.

Quick canary routing playbook (hosted):
- Staging endpoint: endpoint-staging.brightcart.redwood.net (scoped key A) — used for functional tests and warmup.
- Prod endpoint (canary-enabled): endpoint-prod.brightcart.redwood.net (scoped key B).
- Canary rollout: 0% -> 5% (24h) -> 25% (48h) -> 50% (48h) -> 100% (24h). Each step gated by:
  * Error rate < 1% (5xx and client error rate)
  * 95th P95 latency within SLO (we'll instrument tracing)
  * Quality regression checks run on a 50-sample prompt set you provide

Rate limits & quotas for trial keys:
- Default trial key: 200 RPS with soft burst to 350 RPS for smoke runs (we can temporarily raise hard limits if you need sustained higher).
- Token quota: 5M tokens over 7 days for the pilot (can be adjusted with approval).

Operational notes:
- We recommend using prefix caching for common cart prompts to reduce token cost during the ramp.
- We'll expose separate metrics dashboards per endpoint in the Console (latency by route, token usage, error breakdown).
- For production lift we typically recommend a brief dedicated window to provision reserved capacity if your sustained load exceeds shared-hosted economics.

Attached is a short playbook (redwood-playbook-v1.pdf) and the canary checklist CSV I filled out with the proposed ramp windows.

If this looks good I'll schedule the provisioning for Mon morning and create the staging + prod keys.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
